path_r1.desc: Single-bar return 1 bar(s) before the decision bar, in ATR units.

path_r2.desc: Single-bar return 2 bar(s) before the decision bar, in ATR units.

path_r3.desc: Single-bar return 3 bar(s) before the decision bar, in ATR units.

path_r4.desc: Single-bar return 4 bar(s) before the decision bar, in ATR units.

path_r5.desc: Single-bar return 5 bar(s) before the decision bar, in ATR units.

path_r6.desc: Single-bar return 6 bar(s) before the decision bar, in ATR units.

path_r7.desc: Single-bar return 7 bar(s) before the decision bar, in ATR units.

path_r8.desc: Single-bar return 8 bar(s) before the decision bar, in ATR units.

path_r9.desc: Single-bar return 9 bar(s) before the decision bar, in ATR units.

path_r10.desc: Single-bar return 10 bar(s) before the decision bar, in ATR units.

path_r11.desc: Single-bar return 11 bar(s) before the decision bar, in ATR units.

path_r12.desc: Single-bar return 12 bar(s) before the decision bar, in ATR units.

path_body_r1.desc: Candle body as a share of its own high-low range, the decision bar.

path_body_r2.desc: Candle body as a share of its own high-low range, one bar earlier.

path_body_r3.desc: Candle body as a share of its own high-low range, two bars earlier.

path_upper_wick.desc: Upper wick as a share of the decision bar's own high-low range.

path_lower_wick.desc: Lower wick as a share of the decision bar's own high-low range.

path_upcount5.desc: How many of the last 5 bars closed above their own open.

path_upcount10.desc: How many of the last 10 bars closed above their own open.

path_range5_atr.desc: High-low range of the last 5 bars, in ATR units.

path_range10_atr.desc: High-low range of the last 10 bars, in ATR units.

path_range20_atr.desc: High-low range of the last 20 bars, in ATR units.

path_closepos10.desc: Where the decision bar's close sits inside the last 10-bar high-low range (0=low..1=high).

path_closepos20.desc: Where the decision bar's close sits inside the last 20-bar high-low range (0=low..1=high).

path_closepos60.desc: Where the decision bar's close sits inside the last 60-bar high-low range (0=low..1=high).

path_bars_since_hi20.desc: Bars since the highest high of the last 20 bars.

path_bars_since_lo20.desc: Bars since the lowest low of the last 20 bars.

path_with12_atr.desc: How far price had already moved in the trade's direction over the previous 12 bars, in ATR units.

path_with24_atr.desc: How far price had already moved in the trade's direction over the previous 24 bars, in ATR units.

path_with60_atr.desc: How far price had already moved in the trade's direction over the previous 60 bars, in ATR units.

lvl_pdh_atr.desc: Distance from the prior session's high, in ATR units.

lvl_pdl_atr.desc: Distance from the prior session's low, in ATR units.

lvl_pdc_atr.desc: Distance from the prior session's close, in ATR units.

lvl_session_open_atr.desc: Distance from today's own session open, in ATR units.

lvl_orb_hi_atr.desc: Distance from the first-30-minute opening-range high, in ATR units (NaN before it completes).

lvl_orb_lo_atr.desc: Distance from the first-30-minute opening-range low, in ATR units (NaN before it completes).

lvl_vwap_atr.desc: Distance from today's session-cumulative VWAP, in ATR units.

lvl_ema20_atr.desc: Distance from the 20-period EMA on the leg's own bar size, in ATR units.

lvl_ema50_atr.desc: Distance from the 50-period EMA on the leg's own bar size, in ATR units.

lvl_ema200_atr.desc: Distance from the 200-period EMA on the leg's own bar size, in ATR units.

lvl_ema20_60m_atr.desc: Distance from the 20-period EMA on completed 60-minute bars, in ATR units.

lvl_ema50_60m_atr.desc: Distance from the 50-period EMA on completed 60-minute bars, in ATR units.

lvl_sma20d_atr.desc: Distance from the 20-day daily SMA, in daily-ATR units (prior-day-shifted).

lvl_sma50d_atr.desc: Distance from the 50-day daily SMA, in daily-ATR units (prior-day-shifted).

lvl_sma200d_atr.desc: Distance from the 200-day daily SMA, in daily-ATR units (prior-day-shifted).

lvl_prior_week_hi_atr.desc: Distance from the prior calendar week's high, in daily-ATR units.

lvl_prior_week_lo_atr.desc: Distance from the prior calendar week's low, in daily-ATR units.

ind_rsi14_bar.desc: 14-period RSI on the leg's own bar size.

ind_adx14_bar.desc: 14-period ADX (trend strength) on the leg's own bar size.

ind_atr_pctile_bar.desc: Trailing 1-year percentile rank of 14-period ATR on the leg's own bar size.

ind_atr_pctile_60m.desc: Trailing 1-year percentile rank of 14-period ATR on completed 60-minute bars.

ind_atr_pctile_daily.desc: Trailing 1-year percentile rank of 14-period ATR on daily bars (prior-day-shifted).

ind_bbw_pctile_bar.desc: Trailing 1-year percentile rank of Bollinger-band width on the leg's own bar size.

ind_bbw_pctile_60m.desc: Trailing 1-year percentile rank of Bollinger-band width on completed 60-minute bars.

ind_macd_sign_bar.desc: Sign of the MACD histogram (+1/-1/0) on the leg's own bar size.

ind_macd_sign_60m.desc: Sign of the MACD histogram (+1/-1/0) on completed 60-minute bars.

ind_macd_sign_daily.desc: Sign of the MACD histogram (+1/-1/0) on daily bars (prior-day-shifted).

ind_er20_bar.desc: 20-period efficiency ratio (trend vs chop, 0..1) on the leg's own bar size.

ind_er20_daily.desc: 20-period efficiency ratio (trend vs chop, 0..1) on daily bars (prior-day-shifted).

ind_compressed_60m.desc: Whether the 60-minute chart was in a volatility squeeze (coiled) just before entry.

day_prior_range_pctile.desc: Prior day's high-low range, trailing 1-year percentile rank.

day_prior_close_pos.desc: Prior day's close position inside its own high-low range (0..1).

day_gap_pct.desc: Today's open vs yesterday's close, percent.

day_up_streak.desc: Consecutive up/down day count through the prior day (signed).

day_of_week.desc: Day of week the trade entered (Monday=0..Friday=4).

day_minutes_since_open.desc: Minutes from session open to the decision bar.

day_hour.desc: Hour of day (ET) of the decision bar.

vol_last_vs_avg20.desc: Decision bar's volume vs its own trailing-20-bar average.

vol_cum_vs_avg20.desc: Session-to-date cumulative volume vs the average cumulative volume at the same minute over the prior 20 sessions.
